scope.labels: The English trans-units of all 136 default XLF files that sit directly in a system extension's Resources/Private/Language/, across the core. Files in subdirectories of that path are not included; typo3_label_lookup with mode "derive" still computes their translation domain.
scope.components: Hand-curated backend UI components from the styleguide and the backend Sass sources, each with every Sass file it spans. A subset: not every CSS class in the core is described here.
